java.say: Order keeps a list of its lines. Nobody else gets this list: Order owns its lines (composition).
Order makes each line itself. The caller only gives a price and a quantity.
To get the total, Order asks each line for its subtotal. That is delegation: Order passes part of the work to another object.
Each line works out its own subtotal from its own data.
CashRegister also delegates: it asks the order for the total. But it does not own the order; the order comes in as a parameter. That is delegation without composition.
